rationale: The stock gapped up nearly 5% but has fully reversed to the session low on 3.6x relative volume, trading below VWAP and the 5-minute EMA with heavy selling in the last two bars. However, it is sitting just above the prior close and prior-day low support zone while the broad market is risk-on, so neither a fresh short into the low nor a countertrend long offers a clean asymmetric edge; I prefer to wait for a confirmed break of support or a reversal back above the breakdown level.
